title: Vision SAE Sparsity Patterns: Replicating the Language-vs-Vision Gap on Multiple ViTs

original_idea.body:
# Vision SAE Sparsity Patterns: Replicating the Language-vs-Vision Gap on Multiple ViTs

**Problem:** ViT-Prisma reported vision SAEs show different sparsity patterns than language SAEs, on a limited set of ViTs.

**Direction:** Using Prisma's pretrained vision SAEs, compute sparsity statistics (L0, density, dead-feature fraction) across ViT architectures and compare against language-SAE statistics. Pure inference over released SAEs.

**Why it matters:** As safety expands to multimodal, interpretability tools must transfer; characterizing the gap tells the community which language-SAE intuitions survive.

**Relevant context:** ViT-Prisma project: 75+ ViTs, 80+ pretrained SAE weights.
